snapshot.text: Health infrastructure, staff shortages, hospital management and outpatient care development are the main challenges, according to the health minister. Administrative restructuring of health bodies is now being debated, and healthcare-associated infections remain a concern flagged by the OECD.

priorities.title: Administrative reform of health structures
priorities.text: Plans would turn the 28 regional health inspectorates into territorial units of the ministry. The proposals are being opened to broad public discussion, and critics say they weaken regional public health capacity.

priorities.title: Healthcare quality assessment system
priorities.text: The minister considers it realistic that a healthcare quality assessment system will be adopted by the end of this year. She also calls for more transparency on payments made outside mandatory insurance.

priorities.title: Merging emergency medical services
priorities.text: The plan is to combine management of ground and air emergency medical services to reduce reported delays. The minister says no centres or branches would be closed.

netherlands.text: Sofia's ISUL university hospital and Utrecht's Princess Máxima Center signed a memorandum for paediatric cancer care. The Dutch centre will treat complex Bulgarian cases, and the minister backed the initiative.
